post.title: Instagram is free. Meta made $196 billion from ads in 2025.
post.ig:
Instagram is free. Its owner made $196 billion from ads in 2025.
Meta got about 98% of its $201B in revenue from ads, up from $69.7B of ad revenue in 2019. Across 3.58B daily users at the end of 2025, that's roughly $55 per person a year.
In-app purchases: consumers spent $167B inside apps in 2025, and non-game apps outspent games for the first time.
Apple and Google typically take up to 30% of digital purchases.
Sources: Meta FY2025 10-K; Sensor Tower State of Mobile 2026.
News and education, not financial advice.
